summary: Sensus Healthcare, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $15 million revolving credit facility with City National Bank of Florida. The loan bears interest at SOFR plus 3% and matures June 5, 2027, secured by $2.23 million cash collateral and a security interest in all assets. Covenants include a minimum debt service coverage ratio of 1.50 and restrictions on asset sales, additional indebtedness, liens, and removal of specified officers. The filing reflects routine corporate financing, not a special situation.
